Title: Search with valid distinct cities
Steps: Select departure=Paris; destination=Berlin; Click Find Flights
Expected Result: Results list displays flights for the route; no errors; page title reflects route

Title: Prevent same-city route
Steps: Select departure=Paris; destination=Paris; Click Find Flights
Expected Result: Visible validation prevents search; user stays on home page with clear error message

Title: Purchase with invalid expiry month
Preconditions: On purchase page after selecting any flight
Steps: Enter Month=0; valid Year; other fields valid; Click Purchase
Expected Result: Inline error on Month; purchase blocked; no confirmation shown

Title: Price consistency from list to confirmation
Preconditions: Select a specific flight from results
Steps: Capture listed Price P; proceed to purchase and complete; compare confirmation Amount to P (±fees if defined)
Expected Result: Confirmation Amount equals expected total derived from listed price; if fees apply, amounts reconcile per spec
